existing_acceptance.semantics: proof correctness, run completion, signed-run physical quantum, requested/effective generator batching, ingress capacity, chain capacity, validator canonical cleanup, and reproducibility are independent acceptance dimensions

existing_load_level_acceptance.semantics: load_validation proves the offered level only; it does not establish chain capacity

scope: Full generator-run boundary deltas, including ramp/warmup/drain; not a measurement-only cohort.

server.dominance_rule: Strictly more than 50% of server code-651 outcomes; diagnostic only, not a performance or capacity claim.

lifetime_cumulative_maxima.scope: Validator lifetime at before/after full-run boundaries, including earlier work. Never subtract maxima; these are not this run's maxima.

cross_check.semantics: Server rates divide completed physical pool input statuses. Generator rates divide its full-run native parent attempts, including retries/repairs. A server result need not reach the RPC caller; upstream query/cache rejections never reach the pool; code651 includes capacity/watermark categories that the generator can classify separately. Pool batches can include other traffic. Compare category counts as attribution evidence only; equal denominators or retry counts are not required.

strict_image_reuse.semantics: prebuilt images; stable validator container/image and daemon PID/kernel start ticks across setup and load

additional_admission_evidence.scope: All values cover the full generator-run capture. Verification is prechecks plus dispatch/group wall wait, not verifier CPU.

related_pacing_evidence.scope: Measured generator phase only, distinct from server full-run timing. Token accounting closes the offer deficit; it does not establish which server delay caused clipping.

findings: All 41,945 server code-651 outcomes were snapshot_changed (100%); every account-revision, watermark, unavailable-state, capacity and other cause was zero.
The full-run retry rate was 41,945 / 514,952 = 8.1454%. Server completed physical statuses and generator parent attempts happened to match here; the helper does not require denominator equality.
There were 43,154 completed batches, zero final active batches and zero aborted batches. The cumulative peak was 139 active batches; the before-snapshot peak and timing counters were zero.
Mean batch residence was 64.830 ms; prechecks/signature dispatch/group wait averaged 56.019 ms (86.41% of aggregate residence wall time). This is wall residence, not verifier CPU.

Snapshot changes affected 3,548 batches (8.2217% of snapshot checks). Their mean snapshot age was 95.729 ms, versus 63.950 ms overall and 61.103 ms in the remaining checks; longer residence is associated with invalidation, not proven causal.
The generator recorded two timeout task errors in addition to not_ready; server rejections above code-651 likewise numbered two, with no shard-manager await errors. No timeout retry was recorded.

Measured offered load was 55,020 TPS against a 58,000 target (94.8621%) and 55,041.898 canonical TPS. The run failed target attainment and actual offered-above-canonical gates; capacity claims remain disallowed.
limitations: The cause counters locate the rejection guard; they do not reveal whether the new masterchain snapshot retained the same source shard top, config root, signing domain and destination locality. The safely avoidable fraction is unknown.
Server deltas include ramp, warmup and drain. They do not isolate the 60-second measured cohort or compare coalescing modes by themselves.

Stage means and maxima do not provide wait percentiles, scheduler queue depth, verifier CPU cost, or per-parent timing/cause correlation. Timings overlap and must not be added as independent CPU costs.
Maxima are retained as validator-lifetime before/after observations. They are not measurement-window maxima, even though the before counters in this run were zero.
The token deficit reconciles clipping plus boundary balance change, but these aggregates cannot assign clipped tokens specifically to snapshot retries versus other client-capacity delays.
Proof correctness, cleanup, and within-run strict image/daemon continuity passed. A single rejected capacity run does not establish a throughput improvement or repeatability.

recommended_next_bounded_action.action: Prepare a shadow-only exact snapshot-equivalence classifier for snapshot_changed outcomes before relaxing admission policy.
recommended_next_bounded_action.why: Snapshot_changed is the only observed retry cause, but the current telemetry cannot separate harmless masterchain advances from relevant state/config changes.
conditions_to_count_separately: The current masterchain strictly descends from the pinned masterchain, verified by exact block identity/ancestry.
The full config-dictionary root and signing-domain hash are unchanged, including native run mode and lane policy.
The currently referenced source shard has the same full BlockIdExt and verified state evidence as the pinned source view.
Every output remains local to that current source shard and satisfies the same lane policy.
The canonical account revision, nonce interval, balance reservation and existing deadline/expiry conditions remain valid at the final reservation decision.
recommended_next_bounded_action.first_scope: Batch admission only, with counters at the existing rejection point; keep rejection behavior and cache-generation/global-watermark rules unchanged during classification.
tests_before_any_policy_candidate: Accept the classifier only for an ancestor MC advance with equal config/domain/source top and valid destinations.
Reject equal-height different-hash/nonancestor MC, changed config/domain/mode/lane depth, splits/merges or destination remapping.
Reject changed source shard top even when nonce and balance match, and changed account revision or expired/deadline work.
Preserve mixed-source and duplicate-input ordered outcomes; any later await requires refreshing equivalence evidence before a new reservation.
recommended_next_bounded_action.measurement_protocol: If a large equivalent subset is observed and focused tests pass, use prebuilt strict-reuse paired repetitions with unchanged target, credit, proof, cleanup and offered-above-canonical gates.
